goal: An authorized role can trigger a hosted pipeline and attach JUnit, coverage, SARIF, and Playwright artifacts as executed CI evidence on the WorkItem
scenarios: developer or evaluator discovers GitHub Actions, Gitea Actions, or GitLab CI workflows
an authorized role triggers a hosted pipeline for a WorkItem
the service waits until the run completes before recording evidence
JUnit, coverage, SARIF, and Playwright artifacts attach as executed CI evidence
local command-runner CI still works without GitHub
production hosted CI still requires human approval
constraints: core operation does not require GitHub
executed CI evidence is recorded on the WorkItem
